reviews.comment: I had him for COSC 410/411. Genuinely the best professor I have had at TAMU. Cares so much about his students and is very passionate about construction. If you can take him, DO IT!! There was only one assignment for each class, and they were super simple.

Great prof. For the love of god do not skip his class a single day unexcused. I skipped one day that was tied to a homework grade and I did the homework, but since I skipped that 1 class he gave everyone who skipped a zero. He then weighted the homework as a test grade. Again great teacher, but do not skip his class for any unexcused reason.

Very solid class. Similar to Boldt. He may be scary at first but get to know him and you'll find out he's great. Ask questions and see him in office hours. Read the books, go to class, do the practice problems. The only reason people fail this class is because they skip class and miss homeworks and dig themselves into a hole they can't get out of.

This class would be more beneficial if offered on an 8-week basis intead of 16-week. There is too much downtime and redundant lectures. Tests are way too specific, you need remember every word from every slide.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Skip class won't pass. If you do the work and pay attention, you will get a good grade. He is always around for help. More than most professors. Great guy.

Professor Fickel made this class an upper-level one. AVOID FOR 153! HW is difficult and there's only one or two. Pop quizzes every week and the textbook is necessary for passing. Made the intro into this major seem not fun and exciting. other professors have many guest speakers for 153 and with Fickel we only had one or two. PLEASE AVOID
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment:
I actually took Professor Fickel in COSC 410 & COSC 411, but those were not options in the drop-down menu. 

This professor is a stand-up guy & very genuine. During the semester I had him, he dealt with the loss of a loved one, but still showed up to teach the class. He was extremely open with our class about everything, and he is a great leader.

He genuinely cares and provides support for his students. Hard and tedious projects. Even harder tests. But it is all within reason. You will learn in his class at the expense (not too significant) of your social life.
This class was harder than MGMT 209 with Swim. You have to put in A LOT of time to make a good grade. Show up to class and study hard.

Prof. Fickel is one of the few in our department that truly cares about developing us as young professionals and takes a personal interest in getting to know you as a student. Very reasonable guy, will talk to you for 30 minutes to an hour if you need help with something, and won't move on until you fully understand it. Wish he taught more classes.

Solid prof, but lecture heavy. Teaches mostly by the book, so READ and take notes over the powerpoints. He definitely makes you work for your grade, as the tests are usually over 200 textbook pages worth of mtrl. Kind of frustrating bc if you don't remember those 1-2 sentences, you'll get the test question wrong. Usually give 10 pt curves.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY
